source_text.body:
Explain hard concepts to a student in their native language
A teacher gives ChatGPT's real-time voice mode context and lets a struggling student go back and forth in their native language until they understand.
·
Sep 1, 2025
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
One teacher said they use OpenAI Playground’s real-time voice mode on a pay-as-you-go basis when a student is stuck on something complex. The teacher gives the model context first, then lets the student talk back and forth with it in the student’s native language until the idea clicks; the teacher is the one deciding when to bring it in.
How it went
The source only claims it is a great experience for helping students understand hard material. It gives no measured learning results, examples of subjects, or evidence on how often it fails.
Worth knowing
The main catch mentioned is cost: this was done in OpenAI Playground’s real-time voice on a pay-as-you-go basis.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
I'm a teacher helping a student who speaks [native language] understand [topic] in [subject]. Here is the background: [grade level, what they already know, where they're stuck]. Talk with them in [native language] using simple words and everyday examples. Check their understanding with short questions, and keep going back and forth until they can explain the idea back in their own words.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/languagehub/comments/1nocz4l
